# Copilot instructions

Read [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) first: it is the entry point for every agent, Copilot included. It links the universal code standard and every page under [`docs/ai/`](../docs/ai/README.md), and it holds the truth hierarchy.

When reviewing a pull request, follow [`docs/ai/pr-and-ci.md`](../docs/ai/pr-and-ci.md#11-reviewing-a-pr). This file adds nothing of its own, so there is only one place to keep up to date.
